label_semantics.positive_selection: Keep existing 1506/175/160 profitable Grade-A events with original image/box bytes; profit is selection metadata, not evidence to erase nonwinner morphology. Existing positives are rule-labelled, not per-sample Owner gold.
label_semantics.negative_selection: Morphology-only visible whole-window non-dense proof plus known-candidate/manual exclusion. No return/TP/SL/TIMEOUT enters negative eligibility.
label_semantics.unadjudicated: Every prior nonwinner candidate remains quarantined for morphology; no automatic reversal to positive.
label_semantics.evaluation_scope: Matched case-control evaluation on selected winner-pattern positives and verified clear backgrounds; not unconditional morphology recall or proof of profitability. Separate full-candidate economic evaluation retains outcome labels only as trading labels.
label_semantics.hard_negatives: Dense near misses and manual labels with differing windows are review-only until applicable visible morphology evidence is verified; no forced hard-negative quota.

negative_sampling.capacity_failure: Record shortage; never weaken morphology proof/protection/time split or borrow another source.
